Multiple qualifying Zetaris papers and experiments consistently demonstrate that post-quantum anonymity and traceability can be achieved without a single trusted opener. Each paper (P015, P020, P026, P029, P030) reports anonymity=true, traceability=true, and trusted_opener_required=false, with experimental results marked PASS. The claims are uniform across all sources.
